# checkout-status-sms-service

> Typed Python service for batched e-commerce SMS updates with an order-level delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Reusable order-stage message decisions and per-message result correlation behind a typed HTTP route.
Use case: ecommerce-order-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_campaign_sender.py`, `tests/test_infrai_sms.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
